description_en: Queries app instance group reports by region, app instance group, status, user authorization relationship, or statistical date
description_zh: 按地域、交付组、状态、用户授权关系或统计日期查询交付组报表
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center query-app-instance-group-report-list --appstream-center-region-id cn-hangzhou --app-instance-group-id 'aig-9ciijz60n4xsv****' --app-instance-group-name '研发工作站' --status '["PUBLISHED"]' --end-user-id user01 --page-size 100 --page-number 1 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --stat-date 20260901 --start-date 20260901 --end-date 20260930 --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryAppInstanceGroupReportList

parameters.help_en: The region ID for OpenAPI access, which is used for request authentication and routing. To filter business data by region, use `BizRegionId`
parameters.help_zh: OpenAPI 接入地域 ID，用于请求鉴权和路由；业务数据的地域筛选请使用 `BizRegionId`
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the app instance group ID, which matches the exact ID. If this parameter is not specified, the results are not filtered by ID. You can call [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 交付组 ID 筛选条件，按完整 ID 匹配；不传时不按 ID 筛选。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 获取
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The filter condition for the app instance group name, which supports inclusion matching. If this parameter is not specified, the results are not filtered by name
parameters.help_zh: 交付组名称筛选条件，支持包含匹配；不传时不按名称筛选
parameters.name: app_instance_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The list of app instance group statuses. Multiple values have an OR relationship. Unrecognized values do not participate in filtering. If all values are unrecognized, the results are not filtered by status.

Valid values:

`DEPLOYING`: Deploying.
`DEPLOYED`: Deployed but not published.
`PUBLISHED`: Published and available to provide services based on the current configurations.
`STOPPING`: Stopping.
`STOPPED`: Stopped.
`MAINTAINING`: Maintaining.
`FAILED`: Deployment or running failed.
`MAINTAIN_FAILED`: Maintenance failed.
`DELETING`: Deleting.
`DELETED`: Deleted
parameters.help_zh:
交付组状态列表。多个值之间为“或”关系；无法识别的值不会参与过滤，若全部无法识别则等同于不按状态筛选。

取值：

`DEPLOYING`：正在部署。
`DEPLOYED`：部署完成，尚未发布。
`PUBLISHED`：已发布，可按当前配置提供服务。
`STOPPING`：正在停止。
`STOPPED`：已停止。
`MAINTAINING`：正在维护。
`FAILED`：部署或运行失败。
`MAINTAIN_FAILED`：维护失败。
`DELETING`：正在删除。
`DELETED`：已删除
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the end user, which is used to filter app instance groups based on the current valid authorization relationship. Before the call, make sure that the user has at least one valid authorization. If no valid authorization exists, the current version does not narrow down the results based on this parameter. If this parameter is not specified, the results are not filtered by user
parameters.help_zh: 终端用户 ID，用于按当前有效授权关系筛选交付组。调用前应确认该用户至少存在一条有效授权；如果没有有效授权，当前版本不会据此缩小结果范围。不传时不按用户筛选
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 200. The current operation does not have an additional upper limit for a single page
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数。不传时默认 200；当前接口未设置额外的单页上限
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number to query. Specify a value starting from `1`. If this parameter is not specified, the service processes the request as the first page, but the response may return `0`
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的页码。建议从 `1` 开始显式传入；不传时服务按首页处理，但响应可能回显 `0`
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the business region to which the app instance group belongs. You can call [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) to obtain the ID. If this parameter is not specified, the results are not filtered by business region
parameters.help_zh: 交付组所属的业务地域 ID。可调用 [ListRegions](~~ListRegions~~) 获取；不传时不按业务地域筛选
parameters.name: biz_region_id

parameters.help_en: The statistical date for a single day. Format: `yyyyMMdd`. If this parameter is specified along with `StartDate` and `EndDate`, the results must meet both the single-day and interval conditions. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as a natural date in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 单日统计日期，格式：`yyyyMMdd`。与 `StartDate`、`EndDate` 同时传入时，结果须同时满足单日和区间条件。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）的自然日期解释
parameters.name: stat_date

parameters.help_en: The start date of the statistics. Format: `yyyyMMdd`. This parameter must be specified in pairs with `EndDate`, and the interval includes the start and end dates. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as a natural date in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计开始日期，格式：`yyyyMMdd`。必须与 `EndDate` 成对传入，区间包含开始和结束日期。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）的自然日期解释
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The end date of the statistics. Format: `yyyyMMdd`. This parameter must be specified in pairs with `StartDate` and cannot be earlier than the start date. The string itself does not carry a time zone and is interpreted as a natural date in the Asia/Shanghai (UTC+8) time zone
parameters.help_zh: 统计结束日期，格式：`yyyyMMdd`。必须与 `StartDate` 成对传入，且不能早于开始日期。字符串本身不携带时区，按 Asia/Shanghai（UTC+8）的自然日期解释
parameters.name: end_date

Code.description_en: The business status code. A value of `200` indicates that the request is processed. Other values indicate that the processing failed
Code.description_zh: 业务状态码。`200` 表示请求处理成功；其他值表示处理失败
